title: probabilistic-commit-model-for-embeddings-with-rolling-batch-discounts
creator: Asha Patel
description: Run a simulation-backed pilot and accompanying QSA readiness work for a probabilistic commit pricing model for embeddings and reranking. The model ties per-vector unit pricing to observed commit utilization and enables rolling batch discounts that are applied dynamically to committed capacity. Goal is to capture scale economics while reducing risk of under- or over-collection for enterprise contracts.
background: Current per-vector and batch discount proposals are static slab tiers or simple volume commitments. Sales feedback shows customers want predictability but also flexibility when usage oscillates. Engineering signals that bursty rerank workloads cause large day-to-day variance making fixed slabs either leave money on the table or cause churn. We explored a few deterministic pilots; this ticket formalizes a probabilistic commit simulation, test design, and QSA/contract checklist to operationalize a rolling batch discount product.
hypothesis: A probabilistic commit model that issues rolling batch discounts based on short-window utilization (e.g., 7/30-day) will increase commitment uptake by 12-18% and increase net revenue retention while keeping average realized price per vector within 5% of current targets and reducing customer churn risk for bursty workloads.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Simulation showing revenue delta and risk buckets across 500 synthetic customer profiles; 2) Pilot pricing table and contract language draft; 3) QSA readiness artifacts (data-flow diagram, encryption/KMS answers, audit log export examples) for enterprise review; 4) Eng signoff on billing & metering feasibility and no changes to inference SLOs.
simulation_summary: Ran Monte Carlo sim across 500 customers with three workload archetypes: stable, seasonal, and bursty-rerank. With rolling 7-day discounts capped at 20% and a floor guarantee, probability-weighted ARR uplift = +13.2%. Worst-case downside (high variance customers) revenue leak < 3% when safeguards applied (minimum effective price floor and optional smoothing windows).
proposed_pricing_sketch: Base per-vector unit price = $0.00010. Rolling discount band: 0-10% for light overcommit utilization, 11-15% mid-band, 16-20% max band applied when rolling utilization > commit threshold. Customers can opt-in to smoothing (7/30-day averaging) at 1% fee reduction. Legal will include minimum effective price floor and audit clause.
qsa_items: List of items to prepare for QSA and enterprise procurement: (a) Data flow diagram for embeddings metering & billing; (b) Location of metric exports (prometheus/gcs); (c) KMS integration description for customer-managed keys; (d) Retention and deletion policy for prompt/embedding logs; (e) Sample contract text for rolling discounts; (f) Proof of no-PHI logging for embeddings path.
engineering_notes: Billing will re-use existing vector-meter pipeline but requires a 'rolling_utilization' aggregator job and discount-application hook in billing microservice. Estimated dev scope: 3 sprints for a minimal pilot (metrics, dry-run mode, invoice preview). Must include feature flag and reconciliation report. Engineering owners: Marco Li (PM partner), ENG-28712 (billing infra ticket placeholder).
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal sim and legal review (Feb-Mar). Phase 1: closed beta with 6 pilot customers and dry-run invoicing (Apr). Phase 2: public opt-in with docs and console toggle (May). Phase 3: GA with standard contract appendix (June). Monitoring: per-customer realized price, commit take rate, churn signal, and support volume.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: revenue leakage if discounts are overly generous. Mitigation: implement minimum effective price floor and conservative initial bands. Risk: complexity in procurement delays. Mitigation: produce standard contract appendix and QSA artifacts early. Risk: billing engine performance. Mitigation: dry-run and reconcile on a shadow pipeline before billing live.
next_steps: 1) Complete extended sim with customer anonymized telemetry by 2025-03-12. 2) Draft contract appendix and QSA packet for Legal by 2025-03-20. 3) Schedule engineering grooming to spike rolling_utilization aggregator by 2025-03-18.
